title: Access Port Configured in Wrong VLAN

title: Voice and Data VLAN Encapsulation Conflict

ai_root_cause: Interface Fa0/18 is left in dynamic desirable mode with no access VLAN 10 and no auxiliary voice VLAN 150 configured.

title: Inter-VLAN Subinterface Encapsulation Mismatch

title: VTP Domain Mismatch Blocking VLAN Propagation

title: Default Gateway Outside Host Subnet

ai_root_cause: Host default gateway is configured as 10.1.20.1, which belongs to a different subnet than host IP 10.1.10.45/24. Correct gateway is 10.1.10.1.

title: Subnet Mask Mismatch Between Host and Router
expected_fault: PC-3 has subnet mask 255.255.255.128 (/25), splitting 172.16.1.0/24 into two subnets. PC-3 considers gateway 172.16.1.1 on network 172.16.1.0/25 to be in a remote subnet.
ai_root_cause: PC-3 has subnet mask 255.255.255.128 (/25), splitting 172.16.1.0/24 into two subnets. PC-3 considers gateway 172.16.1.1 on network 172.16.1.0/25 to be in a remote subnet.

title: Duplicate IP Address on Local Network
expected_fault: Duplicate IP address 192.168.1.50 statically configured on both Server-A (Fa0/2) and Printer-1 (Fa0/14), causing ARP poisoning and MAC flapping.
ai_root_cause: Duplicate IP address 192.168.1.50 statically configured on both Server-A (Fa0/2) and Printer-1 (Fa0/14), causing ARP poisoning and MAC flapping.

title: Host Assigned Subnet Network Address as Host IP
expected_fault: Laptop-1 is invalidly configured with host IP 10.0.5.0, which is the reserved Subnet/Network ID of 10.0.5.0/24.
ai_root_cause: Laptop-1 is invalidly configured with host IP 10.0.5.0, which is the reserved Subnet/Network ID of 10.0.5.0/24.

title: Missing IP Helper-Address for DHCP Relay
expected_fault: Router interface Gi0/0.10 is missing the 'ip helper-address 192.168.50.10' configuration to relay broadcast DHCP DISCOVER requests across subnets.
ai_root_cause: Router interface Gi0/0.10 is missing the 'ip helper-address 192.168.50.10' configuration to relay broadcast DHCP DISCOVER requests across subnets.

title: DHCP Pool Exhaustion
expected_fault: The DHCP pool subnet is sized at /28 (14 usable addresses) and all 14 addresses have been leased, exhausting the pool for new clients.
ai_root_cause: The DHCP pool subnet is sized at /28 (14 usable addresses) and all 14 addresses have been leased, exhausting the pool for new clients.

title: DHCP Excluded Addresses Missing Gateway IP
expected_fault: No 'ip dhcp excluded-address' statement was defined on the router, causing DHCP to offer the router's own interface IP 192.168.10.1 to clients.
ai_root_cause: No 'ip dhcp excluded-address' statement was defined on the router, causing DHCP to offer the router's own interface IP 192.168.10.1 to clients.

title: DHCP Option 3 (Default Gateway) Misconfigured
expected_fault: The DHCP pool has option 3 configured as default-router 10.0.100.254, but the actual router gateway is 10.0.100.1.
ai_root_cause: The DHCP pool has option 3 configured as default-router 10.0.100.254, but the actual router gateway is 10.0.100.1.

title: DHCP Snooping Untrusted Uplink Port
expected_fault: DHCP snooping was enabled on SW2 without trusting the uplink trunk port Gi0/1 connected to the authorized DHCP server, blocking incoming DHCP OFFER and ACK packets.
ai_root_cause: DHCP snooping was enabled on SW2 without trusting the uplink trunk port Gi0/1 connected to the authorized DHCP server, blocking incoming DHCP OFFER and ACK packets.

title: Incorrect DNS Server IP Configured on Host
expected_fault: DNS Server IP is mistyped as 172.16.5.35 instead of the valid DNS server IP 172.16.5.53.
ai_root_cause: DNS Server IP is mistyped as 172.16.5.35 instead of the valid DNS server IP 172.16.5.53.

title: Missing DNS Domain-Lookup Command on Cisco IOS Router
expected_fault: DNS resolution is globally disabled on the router via 'no ip domain-lookup'.
ai_root_cause: DNS resolution is globally disabled on the router via 'no ip domain-lookup'.

title: Missing A Record on Authoritative DNS Server
expected_fault: The DNS A-record for hostname 'crm.corp.local' is missing in the corp.local forward lookup zone on the DNS server.
ai_root_cause: The DNS A-record for hostname 'crm.corp.local' is missing in the corp.local forward lookup zone on the DNS server.

title: UDP Port 53 Blocked by Perimeter Firewall ACL
expected_fault: ACL OUTSIDE-IN only permits TCP port 53 and denies UDP port 53 return traffic required for standard DNS queries.
ai_root_cause: ACL OUTSIDE-IN only permits TCP port 53 and denies UDP port 53 return traffic required for standard DNS queries.

title: Missing Default Static Route on Edge Router
expected_fault: No default static route (ip route 0.0.0.0 0.0.0.0 198.51.100.1) is configured, leaving Gateway of last resort not set.
ai_root_cause: No default static route (ip route 0.0.0.0 0.0.0.0 198.51.100.1) is configured, leaving Gateway of last resort not set.

title: OSPF Area ID Mismatch Preventing Neighbor Adjacency
expected_fault: OSPF Area mismatch on interconnect link: R1 is in Area 0 while R2 is in Area 1.
ai_root_cause: OSPF Area mismatch on interconnect link: R1 is in Area 0 while R2 is in Area 1.

title: OSPF MTU Mismatch Stuck in EXSTART/EXCHANGE State
expected_fault: MTU mismatch on link (1500 bytes on R1 vs 1400 bytes on R3) causes OSPF Database Description (DBD) packets to be dropped, stalling state in EXSTART.
ai_root_cause: MTU mismatch on link (1500 bytes on R1 vs 1400 bytes on R3) causes OSPF Database Description (DBD) packets to be dropped, stalling state in EXSTART.

title: Static Route Next-Hop Unreachable / Recursive Failure
expected_fault: Static route next-hop 172.16.2.2 is unreachable because the directly connected transit network is 172.16.1.0/30 (R2 is at 172.16.1.2).
ai_root_cause: Static route next-hop 172.16.2.2 is unreachable because the directly connected transit network is 172.16.1.0/30 (R2 is at 172.16.1.2).

title: Passive Interface Configured on Active Routing Link
expected_fault: Interface Gi0/0 is erroneously configured as passive-interface, suppressing OSPF Hello packet transmission on the router-to-router link.
ai_root_cause: Interface Gi0/0 is erroneously configured as passive-interface, suppressing OSPF Hello packet transmission on the router-to-router link.

title: Asymmetric Routing Causing TCP Connection Reset
expected_fault: Asymmetric routing path causes return TCP SYN-ACK traffic to bypass the stateful firewall FW1, resulting in TCP teardown.
ai_root_cause: Asymmetric routing path causes return TCP SYN-ACK traffic to bypass the stateful firewall FW1, resulting in TCP teardown.

title: VLAN 30 PC Cannot Reach Server Due to Implicit Deny
expected_fault: Outbound ACL 'BLOCK-OLD' on Gi0/0.10 only permits 192.168.20.0/24; VLAN 30 (192.168.30.0/24) traffic is dropped by the implicit deny any.
ai_root_cause: Outbound ACL 'BLOCK-OLD' on Gi0/0.10 only permits 192.168.20.0/24; VLAN 30 (192.168.30.0/24) traffic is dropped by the implicit deny any.

title: Inverted Wildcard Mask in Extended ACL
expected_fault: The wildcard mask in ACL rule 10 was entered as a subnet mask '255.255.255.0' instead of Cisco inverse wildcard mask '0.0.0.255'.
ai_root_cause: The wildcard mask in ACL rule 10 was entered as a subnet mask '255.255.255.0' instead of Cisco inverse wildcard mask '0.0.0.255'.

title: ACL Applied in Wrong Direction (Outbound vs Inbound)
expected_fault: ACL 'MGMT-FILTER' is applied with 'out' keyword on Gi0/0 instead of 'in'. It filters traffic exiting the interface toward the Admin PC rather than ingress traffic.
ai_root_cause: ACL 'MGMT-FILTER' is applied with 'out' keyword on Gi0/0 instead of 'in'. It filters traffic exiting the interface toward the Admin PC rather than ingress traffic.

title: Standard ACL Placed Too Close to Source
expected_fault: Standard ACL 10 (which filters only by source IP) was placed inbound near the source on Gi0/0, blocking Host A from all destinations instead of specifically the Payroll subnet.
ai_root_cause: Standard ACL 10 (which filters only by source IP) was placed inbound near the source on Gi0/0, blocking Host A from all destinations instead of specifically the Payroll subnet.

title: Missing Established Keyword in Return Traffic ACL
expected_fault: Inbound ACL on WAN interface has no 'permit tcp any 192.168.1.0 0.0.0.255 established' rule, causing all return TCP packets for client web sessions to be dropped.
ai_root_cause: Inbound ACL on WAN interface has no 'permit tcp any 192.168.1.0 0.0.0.255 established' rule, causing all return TCP packets for client web sessions to be dropped.

title: Missing IP NAT Inside/Outside Interface Configuration
expected_fault: WAN interface GigabitEthernet0/1 is missing the 'ip nat outside' command, preventing NAT translation evaluation.
ai_root_cause: WAN interface GigabitEthernet0/1 is missing the 'ip nat outside' command, preventing NAT translation evaluation.

title: NAT Overload (PAT) Keyword Omitted
expected_fault: The 'overload' keyword was omitted from the 'ip nat inside source list 1 interface Gi0/1' statement, creating a 1-to-1 dynamic NAT mapping that exhausts the single public IP.
ai_root_cause: The 'overload' keyword was omitted from the 'ip nat inside source list 1 interface Gi0/1' statement, creating a 1-to-1 dynamic NAT mapping that exhausts the single public IP.

title: NAT Source ACL Does Not Match New Subnet
expected_fault: Standard ACL 1 used for NAT only permits subnet 192.168.10.0/24; subnet 192.168.20.0/24 is not permitted in the NAT ACL.
ai_root_cause: Standard ACL 1 used for NAT only permits subnet 192.168.10.0/24; subnet 192.168.20.0/24 is not permitted in the NAT ACL.

title: Static NAT Port Forwarding Wrong Inside IP
expected_fault: Static NAT port forwarding statement has a typo in the internal private IP (configured as 192.168.1.180 instead of real server IP 192.168.1.80).
ai_root_cause: Static NAT port forwarding statement has a typo in the internal private IP (configured as 192.168.1.180 instead of real server IP 192.168.1.80).

title: WPA2-PSK Key Mismatch on Wireless Client
expected_fault: Preshared key mismatch on wireless client due to case-sensitivity ('Ciscosecure2026!' vs AP key 'CiscoSecure2026!').
ai_root_cause: Preshared key mismatch on wireless client due to case-sensitivity ('Ciscosecure2026!' vs AP key 'CiscoSecure2026!').

title: AP Ethernet Port Configured as Access Instead of Trunk
expected_fault: Switch port Fa0/24 connected to multi-SSID Access Point is configured as an access port in VLAN 10 rather than an 802.1Q trunk port carrying both VLAN 10 and VLAN 20.
ai_root_cause: Switch port Fa0/24 connected to multi-SSID Access Point is configured as an access port in VLAN 10 rather than an 802.1Q trunk port carrying both VLAN 10 and VLAN 20.

title: Wireless Client Band / Channel Mismatch (5GHz 802.11ac)
expected_fault: The 2.4GHz radio (Dot11Radio 0) is administratively shutdown on the AP, leaving only the 5GHz radio active which the legacy 2.4GHz client cannot detect.
ai_root_cause: The 2.4GHz radio (Dot11Radio 0) is administratively shutdown on the AP, leaving only the 5GHz radio active which the legacy 2.4GHz client cannot detect.

title: Native VLAN Mismatch on 802.1Q Trunk Link
expected_fault: Native VLAN mismatch across the trunk link: SW1 has Native VLAN 1 while SW2 has Native VLAN 99.
ai_root_cause: Native VLAN mismatch across the trunk link: SW1 has Native VLAN 1 while SW2 has Native VLAN 99.

title: Required VLAN Not in Trunk Allowed List
expected_fault: Trunk interface Gi0/1 on SW1 restricts allowed VLANs to '1-40', pruning/blocking VLAN 50 traffic from traversing the trunk.
ai_root_cause: Trunk interface Gi0/1 on SW1 restricts allowed VLANs to '1-40', pruning/blocking VLAN 50 traffic from traversing the trunk.

title: Interface Administratively Shutdown
expected_fault: Interface GigabitEthernet0/1 has the 'shutdown' command active in its configuration.
ai_root_cause: Interface GigabitEthernet0/1 has the 'shutdown' command active in its configuration.

title: Duplex Mismatch (Full Duplex vs Half Duplex)
expected_fault: Duplex mismatch: SW1 Fa0/24 is hardcoded to Full-Duplex while R1 Fa0/0 is hardcoded to Half-Duplex, causing collisions and frame drops under load.
ai_root_cause: Duplex mismatch: SW1 Fa0/24 is hardcoded to Full-Duplex while R1 Fa0/0 is hardcoded to Half-Duplex, causing collisions and frame drops under load.
